journey.name: Customize and save a layout
journey.description: Start on Controller with Bluetooth stopped, default layout, portrait or tall window. Reserve Journey-Core-Layout for this run; it must not already exist. Test creates a profile and changes the active layout.

actions.action: Tap Customize.
Verify that Customize Layout is visible.
Tap the left stick in the editor canvas to select it.
Tap Center X in the selected control inspector.
Verify that the selected control inspector shows X: 50%.
Tap Profiles in the editor toolbar.
Tap Save Current As New.
Tap Layout Name and enter Journey-Core-Layout.
Tap Save layout.
Tap Search layouts and enter Journey-Core-Layout.
Verify that the Journey-Core-Layout card is visible and marked Active.
Tap Close.
Press Android Back.
Tap Layouts.
Tap Search layouts and enter Journey-Core-Layout.
Tap Active or Load on the Journey-Core-Layout card.
Tap Close.
Tap Customize.
Tap the left stick in the editor canvas.
Verify that its inspector still shows X: 50%.
Press Android Back.
